t: On charity that is not seen
a: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
p: Inna-l-muṣṣaddiqīna wa-l-muṣṣaddiqāti wa aqraḍu-llāha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum wa lahum ajrun karīm.
m: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
